Content: A telecommunications company offers a trade-in credit for older smartphones. They give a baseline credit of `$120` for any working device. However, for every deep scratch on the screen, the trade-in value decreases by a fixed amount of `$15`.
Which of the following functions, `V(s)`, models the final trade-in value, in `text(dollars)`, of a smartphone with `s` scratches?

A commercial aircraft takes off and climbs to its cruising altitude at a constant rate. Its altitude, in feet, starts at sea level (`text(0 feet)`) and increases by `text(2,200 feet)` for `text(every minute)` it spent climbing.
Which function, `A(m)`, represents the airplane's cruising altitude, in `text(feet)`, as a function of `m`, the number of `text(minutes)` spent climbing?

An online business sells handcrafted ceramic mugs for `$25` each. To encourage bulk buying, the business charges a flat shipping and handling fee of `$8` for the entire order, regardless of how many mugs are purchased.
Which function, `C(m)`, represents the total cost, in `text(dollars)`, of an order as a function of `m`, the number of mugs purchased?

A community garden uses a large rain barrel to water vegetables. At the start of a dry week, the barrel is completely full and holds `text(300 gallons)` of water. `text(Each day)` the garden is watered, `text(12 gallons)` are drained from the barrel.
Which function, `W(d)`, models the remaining volume of water in the barrel, in `text(gallons)`, after `d` `text(days)` of watering?

A freelance graphic designer takes on a large corporate branding project. The client pays a flat contract signing bonus of `$500` before any work begins, plus an `text(hourly)` rate of `$45` for the actual design labor.
Which function, `E(h)`, represents the designer's total earnings, in `text(dollars)`, based on `h`, the number of `text(hours)` spent working on the project?

A mobile car detailing service charges a flat equipment and travel fee just to drive out to a client's home. In addition to this travel fee, they charge a fixed `text(hourly)` rate for the actual cleaning labor. A customer notices that a `text(3-hour)` detailing job costs a total of `$175`, while a `text(5-hour)` detailing job costs a total of `$255`.
What is the `text(hourly)` labor rate, in `text(dollars per hour)`, charged by the service?

An environmental engineering team uses a heavy-duty pump to drain an excavated construction pit flooded with rainwater. The pump removes water at a constant rate. After the pump has run continuously for `text(4 hours)`, there are `text(6,200 gallons)` of water left in the pit. After `text(9 hours)` of continuous pumping, there are `text(3,700 gallons)` left.
What was the initial number of `text(gallons)` of water in the pit before the pumping began?

An educational publishing company hires freelance writers to draft chapters for a new online science curriculum. The company pays each writer a flat bonus just for signing the contract, plus a fixed amount of money for `text(each completed page)` of content. One writer completes `15` pages and earns a total of `text($1,150)`. Another writer completes `22` pages and earns a total of `text($1,570)`.
What is the flat contract signing bonus, in `text(dollars)`, paid to each writer?

A meteorologist launches a weather balloon to track atmospheric changes. The balloon records that the outside air temperature drops at a constant rate for `text(every thousand feet)` it climbs. At an altitude of `text(3,000 feet)`, the recorded temperature is `text(61°F)`. By the time the balloon climbs to an altitude of `text(8,000 feet)`, the temperature has dropped to `text(41°F)`.
What is the rate of change in temperature, in `text(degrees Fahrenheit per thousand feet)`, as the balloon ascends?

During a busy morning rush, a local coffee shop's automated mobile ordering system has a large backlog of drink orders waiting to be filled. The baristas work at a perfectly constant speed to clear the queue. After `text(10 minutes)` of continuous work, there are still `42` mobile orders left in the system backlog. After `text(25 minutes)`, the remaining backlog drops to `12` orders.
At what constant rate, in `text(orders per minute)`, are the baristas clearing the backlog?
